methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.

original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.

actual_scope: Exact arbitrary-dirty iff condition for absorbing one PR1062 terminal helper-star restoration into exactly two existing A writes of its centre before the first centre read, toggling one non-target donor per writer. Exhaust all 236 source edges and 414 eligible writer pairs.
scope_change_reason: PR1194/1311 already cover fully restored semantic D. PR1868 supplies single-writer absorption and explicitly leaves multi-gate splits open. This investigates only the two-writer, one-toggle-per-writer subclass, retaining the original frame contract.
bottleneck_link: A scalar restoration saving is not a paid interface improvement. Every exact two-toggle completion here violates a rational monotone-frame containment, so its tempting scalar saving cannot be used as a legal supplier bill.
stop_rule: Complete the 414 writer pairs and 549 first donors per pair using the unique exact second-donor lookup; replay every exact completion, then stop without widening the gate alphabet.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 227286 first-donor trials, 314 exact dirty completions, 52 reducing ADD count by one, zero frame-legal completions. Every exclusion has an exact rational source-label noncontainment witness. Source-bound legal single-writer positive and seven failure controls.
